description: Add a new variant to an existing product (size/color/SKU permutation with its own price and inventory).

variant.description: Shopify variant object. Typical: option1, option2, option3, price, sku, barcode, inventory_management ('shopify' | null), inventory_policy ('deny' | 'continue'), inventory_quantity, weight, weight_unit, taxable, requires_shipping.

name: create_variant
